comment.comment:
I think we're currently coming out of an AI bubble, which is something worth considering, especially when it comes to crypto projects that were somewhat connected to the stock market.

The stock market has recently experienced a massive correction, and at this point, nobody really knows what comes next. We've also gone through multiple hacks, not only in crypto but across the world in general. This will likely create a much more cautious sentiment towards technology-related projects. As a result, people will be less willing to risk their capital on tech and AI plays.

So, what could potentially become the next narrative? Memecoins.

Right now, there aren't really any brand-new memecoins that launched just a month ago and could become the next big thing. People might theoretically start trading coins like Cashcat & AI etc. But remember that these coins still have bagholders, and we all know that coins with heavy bagholder distribution are never ideal.

At the end of the day, memecoins and other crypto projects are all driven by trends. It's always an up-and-down cycle. That's essentially how narratives work.

So, here's what I'm currently doing. I'm willing to take my first bet on MIHAO for a few reasons.

First, Ansem is the creator, and I genuinely believe he knows exactly what he's doing.

Second, I think the community could potentially attract people from the WIF community. Also could make this a much bigger bet for me. Why? Because we're talking about people, not technology. No AI, no complicated tech narrative, just people and community.

Third, projects like memecoins don't carry the same technological attack surface as complex tech or AI projects. Memecoins are essentially built around people, belief, and collective conviction. That's the narrative.

That's why I see this as my bet on a potential bull run. And by bull run, I don't necessarily mean something lasting for years. I'm talking about a few weeks, maybe one or two months. We'll see.

I think we're slowly approaching another trenches phase, similar to when projects like PONS started appearing. Back then, people had absolutely no idea what was happening because they simply weren't paying attention to what was going on on-chain.

In my opinion, the current moment is a very good opportunity to do research, lock in, and prepare for what's coming.
